fields.title: Kopra Yusō oyobi Haikyō Keiyaku Sho (Copra Transport and Distribution Agreement)

contract.subject: Kopra no yusō oyobi shukka ryō no wariawase ni kansuru keiyaku

agreement.purpose: Chiiki shijō ni okeru kopra no kyōkyū to yusō suijun no kisei.
terms: Keiyaku sha wa shitei sareta kikan nai ni kopra o yusō suru gimu o ou.
Haikei yusōryō ga chūshi sareta baai, songai baishō o seikyū suru kenri o yū suru.

party_a: Maisū no kopra seisanbutsu o kitei no kikan e honsō suru koto.
party_b: Yusō senpaku no teikyō to keiyaku jō no torihiki kessai o hoshō suru koto.

claims.fact: Keiyaku sho wa kopra no yusō gimu to misetsutei na wariawase hōsei o shōmei shite iru.
